issue.title: New settings page listing upcoming booking reminders
issue.body: Harness test (new screen). Add a new page under Settings where users see the reminder emails scheduled for their upcoming bookings (booking title, attendee, send time), read-only. Empty state when there are none.

pm.summary: New read-only Settings page is feasible UI-wise, but the codebase has no model of scheduled reminders with send times. I need a decision on the data source before design.
acceptance_criteria: A new entry appears in the Settings navigation and opens the new page for a logged-in user.
The page lists reminders for the user's upcoming bookings only (not past or cancelled bookings).
Each row shows booking title, attendee, and scheduled send time, shown in the user's timezone.
The page is read-only: no edit, cancel or create actions.
When there are no upcoming reminders, an empty state with explanatory text is shown.
A user sees only their own bookings' reminders, never other users'.
All visible strings are translated via the i18n locale file.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to login.
questions: The code has no data on scheduled reminder emails (ReminderMail only logs sent pending-confirmation reminders, with no send time). Should the page show computed reminders (e.g. derived from booking start time minus a fixed offset), or should we limit scope to something else?
